messages:
maya-cs: quick check-in — OrbitPay prod saw a spike in error rate starting ~14:18 UTC. 5xxs and timeouts up ~4x vs baseline. Sharing the short triage notes and top failing endpoints so eng can take a look. cc @sam-eng @kevin-sre :face_with_thermometer:

sam-eng: on it. can you paste the top endpoints you saw? any recent config changes or deployments?

maya-cs: no customer-side config changes reported; they were running onboarding batch tests. From SLO dashboard: p50 ~120ms (ok), p95 jumped to ~620ms, errors concentrated in three routes below (last 30m):
- /v1/chat/completions (POST) — 38% of errors (mostly 502/504)
- /v1/embeddings (POST) — 29% (timeouts + 429s)
- /v1/streams/ws (upgrade) — 18% (connection timeouts)

jordan-obs: correlating logs now. seeing a flurry of backend 502s from model shard pool around 14:17:30. sample trace id: `6f3a9e02`. snippet: `gateway -> runtime: rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded`

sam-eng: thanks. looking at runtime metrics — KV cache miss rate spiked on that tenant by ~70% which could explain extra latency and backpressure. also noticed a canary model variant was promoted for OrbitPay yesterday (quantized v2). rolling back that variant might isolate cause.

kevin-sre: before rollback, can we confirm capacity pressure? GPU pool utilization for the dedicated tenant at 14:20 showed 92% busy, and connection queues lengthened. I can temporarily enable burst capacity + increase request timeouts on the ingress to reduce 504s.

maya-cs: customer is in onboarding window and has heavy embedding tests — they are sensitive to delays. They asked for ETA on mitigation.

sam-eng: quick plan: 1) revert canary model variant to baseline (done in 2m) 2) enable short-term burst capacity + relax idle timeout on streams 3) watch for error-rate fall and p95 regressions. will post updates.

deploy-bot: revert-canary-orbitpay succeeded — deployment id `deploy-8392` — 1729901325

sam-eng: after revert and enabling burst pool, errors dropped ~60% within 3 minutes. p95 reduced to ~240ms and connection timeouts decreased substantially. still seeing a small number of 429s on embeddings — likely rate-limited from client retries.

kevin-sre: I adjusted the ingress rate-limit bucket for OrbitPay from 800r/s -> 1100r/s for 10m window to drain backlog. will reset and follow up with policy suggestions.

maya-cs: great, please confirm whether we should advise OrbitPay to stagger onboarding test jobs or throttle client-side retries.

sam-eng: recommend both: ask them to pause high-concurrency embedding sweeps for 20m, and implement exponential backoff retries. I'll also push a short runbook note to their account doc.

jordan-obs: adding follow-ups to observability: 1) add alert for tenant-specific cache-miss > 40% 2) alert when GPU pool utilization >85% for >5m 3) log more model-variant changes against tenant id for quicker triage.

maya-cs: thanks team. I'll notify OrbitPay support contact with summary and ask them to confirm when they resume tests. tagging this as "resolved-ish" pending customer throttle. :white_check_mark:

sam-eng: filing a small postmortem + model-variant checklist so canary promotions include a brief load test.

kevin-sre: i'll follow up with a short-term quota recommendation for OrbitPay to avoid repeated bursts during onboarding.

maya-cs: follow-up actions for CS: send recap, schedule 30-min sync with OrbitPay next Tue, capture customer feedback about onboarding docs.

sam-eng: noted. closing thread unless anyone sees new spikes.

maya-cs: closing — will reopen if errors reappear. :lock:
